lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-intensity circular white spots arranged in approximately five vertical columns on the mid-lateral flank. The central column contains four distinct, evenly spaced local maxima.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity run perpendicular to the body axis, with high-luminance blobs situated at the intersections, creating a grid-like configuration across the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent horizontal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp transition from high-luminance pixels on the dorsal edge to low-luminance shadow on the ventral edge of each ridge.

other_distinctive_markers: A dense field of small, circular high-intensity spots is visible on the leading edge and dorsal surface of the primary pectoral fin. A small, dark, elongated silhouette is present near the ventral midline.
